svg.title: CO2-Response: every connection of the Uno R4 board
svg.text: CO2-Response · every connection, pin by pin (Uno R4 board, parts as ordered)

W = wire (numbers match the wire list in docs/wiring.md) · C = USB cable · P = power plug · T = tube or fitting. Not in the purchase documents: the breadboard, jumper wires, USB cables C1 and C2; R1, R2, D1 only as the component kit. A dot joins a wire to a rail.
(isolated USB) · GND = every ground. Never join the two +5 V rails.
top view · 5 V logic · max 8 mA per pin
built-in LED on D13 = the alarm light (nothing to wire)
Check the board's markings for the
Use data cables, not charge-only ones.
in the breathing circuit · no wires to the board
laptop on battery with a subject
top: 3 V side · bottom: 5 V side
normally open · closes < 13 mm from the magnet
(main circuit in grey; the CO2 sample line in green)
room air / cal gas for the zero
tube on one barb, out the other
the inlet: 2 mm ID, 4.3 mm OD
the outlet: 1 mm ID, 4.3 mm OD
exhaust back into the bag side
Wire colours (suggested; keep red, orange and black for power)
ground (W2, W5, W10, W13, W19; W20 joins the two GND rails)
Jumpers: male-to-male from the Arduino's headers to the breadboard; female-to-male onto a sensor's header pins; solder the pump's contacts. The Arduino's GND pins are joined inside the board.
